summary_en: Ordinary dividend ¥3/share for FY2027/3 period end. Special dividend considered if FY2027/3 results are exceptionally strong AND BTC price on 31 Mar 2027 exceeds $90k (vs. earnings forecast range of $86k–$116k). Special dividend amount and implementation contingent on profit level, cash flow, financial condition, distributable capacity under Company Law, and growth investment needs. Target: ¥5+/share combined if conditions met.
title_en: Notice regarding FY2027/3 dividend forecast and shareholder return policy (special dividend)
translation_en_brief: Remixpoint announced a dividend policy for FY2027/3 (year ending 31 March 2027) in a board resolution dated 18 June 2026. The company will pay an ordinary dividend of ¥3 per share at the period end. Additionally, if FY2027/3 results are judged to be exceptionally strong, the company will consider paying a special dividend on top of the ordinary dividend, targeting a combined period-end dividend of ¥5 or more per share. The decision to pay a special dividend and its amount will be based on a multifactorial assessment: whether the BTC price on 31 March 2027 exceeds $90,000 (the company's earnings forecast assumes a BTC range of $86,000–$116,000), profit level, cash flow, financial condition, distributable capacity under the Company Law, and funds needed for future growth investments. The company balances stable ordinary dividends as the foundation of shareholder returns with discretionary special dividends when conditions permit, while simultaneously pursuing growth investments in energy, energy-storage solutions, and digital asset management.
